threads.body: [Javaagent] This registry entry also changes outbound HTTP span parenting on Ratpack 1.7+. `OpenTelemetryHttpClient` selects `Execution.current().maybeGet(Context.class)` before `Context.current()` (lines 35–36). With controller telemetry disabled, a request intercepted while an application child span is current now uses the registered server context instead, making the client span a sibling of that child span. Store the error target in a dedicated registry holder and update the error lookup, or adjust client parent selection to preserve active descendant contexts. Add a regression test for an outbound request inside an application child span with controller telemetry disabled.

replies.body:
Addressed in 68a781675763fb0fed2cf4a9f9179623265cb0de.

Confirmed that OpenTelemetryHttpClient prefers the execution registry Context over Context.current(), and reproduced a client span parented to the server instead of the application child. Commit 1 removes the disabled-controller generic Context entry, registers a dedicated ErrorContext for both controller modes, and reads that holder in ServerErrorHandlerInstrumentation. Existing enabled-controller client registration is unchanged. Outbound and downstream parent-chain coverage passes on Ratpack 1.4.1 and 1.7.0, alongside synchronous, blocking, overlapping asynchronous, and forked error-attribution coverage.
